page: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance architected for graphics-intensive and machine learning tasks requiring dedicated compute, high GPU memory capacity, and integrated fast local storage. The platform runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C x86_64 processor clocked at 2.4 GHz, providing 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Memory comprises 64 GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM running at 6 GHz, offering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. In addition, the instance includes 1900 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage and offers 50 Gbps baseline network throughput.

At the core of the instance acceleration capabilities is a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU equipped with 96 GB of dedicated VRAM. Benchmark measurements demonstrate top-tier execution in large language model inference, delivering 11513.01 prompt tokens per second and 629.25 generation tokens per second on 135M parameter models, alongside 7273.65 prompt tokens and 222.04 generation tokens per second on 7B parameter models. Single-core processing is equally robust, showing top-tier Geekbench single-core and text processing scores, supported by Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction extensions. Single-threaded data compression also ranks in the upper quartile.

Tradeoffs reflect the resource allocation of the 8-vCPU tier. Multithreaded CPU benchmarks, PassMark CPU scores, and uncached DDR5 memory bandwidth align within average ranges compared to systems featuring higher core counts. The cost profile is balanced through dense GPU video memory allocation and bundled high-speed NVMe capacity on a relatively compact CPU footprint, minimizing idle CPU overhead for GPU-centric operations. As a result, the g7e.2xlarge is well tailored for generative AI inference, high-resolution rendering, computer-aided design, computer vision pipelines, and applications requiring rapid local disk caching.
description: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by a dedicated 4-core, 8-vCPU Intel Xeon 8559C processor clocked at 2.4 GHz and paired with a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU providing 96 GB of VRAM. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, the hardware configuration includes 64 GB of DDR5 system memory operating at 6 GHz, 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a 50 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark evaluations highlight exceptional single-core compute and LLM prompt processing and text generation performance across small and medium model sizes, reaching top-tier output rates. While CPU multi-core execution and uncached memory bandwidth show average throughput in line with its 8-vCPU count, the substantial GPU memory and bundled local NVMe storage deliver strong resource density for GPU-bound workloads. This configuration is suitable for machine learning inference, graphics-intensive rendering, workstation virtualization, and local dataset processing.
